about.label: About
about.heading: Builder first, executive second.
about.p1: I'm CTO of Socialist Agency, a social media and digital marketing agency operating across Egypt and the GCC. I built the company's website, client-facing tools, and the internal work planner the whole team runs on — from the content calendar to invoicing.
about.p2: I'm also CTO of ReachFlex, a call-center and BPO outsourcing provider. I designed and built their entire operations platform from scratch: staffing schedules, agent QA, account management, seat-based invoicing, and automated monthly PDF reports.
about.p3: I build bilingual (Arabic/English) products for the GCC market, where most tools weren't designed with RTL or local business logic in mind. That gap is where I work.

projects.title: Socialist Agency
projects.description: Full marketing website + internal work planner. Content calendar, client pipeline, invoice tracker, budget, blog editor. The whole team runs on this daily.

projects.title: ReachFlex Hub
projects.description: Operations dashboard for a BPO company. Staffing schedules, agent roster & QA, account SLA tracking, sales pipeline, seat-based invoicing, and automated monthly PDF reports.

projects.title: Zoud — Al-Hout Seafood
projects.description: Restaurant brand built from the ground up. Bilingual web app, Flutter mobile app, REST API, and socket-based chat server for order coordination.

projects.title: Teqball KSA
projects.description: Launched an unknown sport in Saudi Arabia. Bilingual landing page for official Teqball table sales, paired with a social media campaign across Instagram and B2B email outreach to 33+ sectors.

projects.title: Alhout Seafood — Social
projects.description: Built Alhout's entire social presence from zero. TikTok-first visual content optimized for the For You page. One video hit 307K views and pulled 130 new followers in a single day.
